expressions.cue: A loose handout contains three sheets per complete copy. Write the count for ten complete copies using 部, not the sheet total.
expressions.explanation: 部 counts complete copies. The ten copies contain thirty sheets altogether, but 十部 is still the requested copy count; no contraction to じゅっぷ occurs.

expressions.cue: Eleven copies of the same book were ordered. Write the complete-copy count using 部, not 冊.
expressions.explanation: The final 一部 keeps いちぶ. 冊 can also count the physical bound books, but this form drill explicitly requests 部.

expressions.cue: Ask how many complete copies of an application form are required. Write only the question quantity using 何 and 部.
expressions.explanation: 何部 asks how many complete copies, not how many sheets are in one copy. 部 does not require the document to have only one page.
